SAAS RENEWAL PLANNER · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER

Eight SaaS renewals coming: which do you negotiate first, and when does the window close?

Most contracts auto-renew at a higher price unless you give notice by a date written in the order form, and the seats you pay for are rarely the seats people use. Paste your subscriptions — renewal date, notice days, seats paid and used, the proposed increase — and get the last day to act on each one, the renewals ranked by what negotiating could save, a target price for each, an email draft and a calendar file of the deadlines.

For founders, finance and operations leads and IT managers who own a list of SaaS renewals. Nothing is uploaded: the text box is analysed in this browser and never leaves your device.

1. Paste your subscriptions

2. The plan

#VendorStatusNotice byDays leftSeatsIf renewed as-isTargetCould save

    Email draft

    Prefer a CLI?

    Same logic, zero dependencies, reads a file or stdin:

    node cli.mjs plan renewals.csv --as-of 2026-10-02 --ask 10 --json
node cli.mjs email renewals.csv --vendor Slack
node cli.mjs ics renewals.csv > renewals.ics

    Get cli.mjs and engine.mjs — Node 18+, nothing to install, no network call. More: When do I need to cancel a SaaS auto-renewal? Notice windows and seat right-sizing.

    What's recognised

    InputHandling

    The plan is arithmetic on the numbers you type. It does not read your contracts: termination-for-convenience clauses, price caps, minimum commitments, multi-year terms, true-up rights and early-renewal discounts are not modelled, and your order form controls. Seat counts come from your admin console; the tool does not connect to any vendor.

    Common questions

    Does it upload my vendor list?

    No. The browser page works on the text you paste, in your own browser, and never sends it anywhere. The CLI reads a local file or stdin and makes no network call.

    How is the notice deadline calculated?

    It is the renewal date minus the notice days in your contract. After that date an auto-renewing contract has, in practice, already renewed, so the plan flags it as locked in and moves it down the list.

    How are the savings worked out?

    Right-sizing keeps the seats you used plus a buffer you choose, at the price per seat you pay today, with no price uplift. Your ask is a further percentage off that. Both are compared with renewing as-is at the vendor's proposed increase.

    Will the vendor agree?

    Maybe not. The tool tells you what to ask for and by when; discounts, minimum seat counts and multi-year terms are the vendor's to agree. Read your own order form before you rely on any figure.

    Who is it for?

    Founders, finance and operations leads, and IT managers who own a list of SaaS renewals and want to know which to renegotiate first and when the window closes.

when-do-i-need-to-cancel-a-saas-auto-ren.text:
SaaS Renewal Planner · guide

When do I need to cancel a SaaS auto-renewal? Notice windows and seat right-sizing

Short answer: the last day is the renewal date minus the notice days in your order form, and the time to start talking is a month before that. After it, most auto-renewing contracts have renewed for a full term at the vendor's proposed price, so the conversation that could have saved money turns into a request for a favour.

A worked list

Eight subscriptions costing $228,600.00 a year, seen on 2 October 2026, with a 10% spare-seat buffer, a 10% extra ask and talks starting 30 days before each notice date.

  • Salesforce renews on 15 December with 60 days' notice, so the last day is 2026-10-16, 14 days away. Only 51 of 80 seats are used. Renewing 57 seats at today's price instead of all 80 at the proposed 9% increase turns $104,640.00 into $68,400.00: $36,240.00 saved, or $43,080.00 with the extra ask.
  • Slack's notice date is 2026-10-31, 29 days away, and is worth $8,352.00 to $10,598.40.
  • Figma, Zoom and DocuSign are already past their notice dates. They are probably committed, so the move is to ask for fewer seats or a credit at the next anniversary and to diarise next year's date.
  • Asana does not auto-renew, so there is no lock-in date; it simply lapses unless someone renews it.
  • Across the list, negotiating the live renewals is worth about $65,070.00 (right-size and no uplift) to $83,250.00 (with the extra ask).

What to feed it

  1. From each order form: the renewal date, the notice period, whether it auto-renews and the proposed or capped increase.
  2. From each admin console: seats paid and seats used in the last term, not the headcount.
  3. Your own choices: how many spare seats to keep, how much extra to ask for, and how early to start.

Read the contract itself before relying on a date: some require written notice to a named address, count days differently, or give a right to reduce seats mid-term.

Questions

When do I need to cancel a SaaS auto-renewal?

Before the notice date in your order form: the renewal date minus the notice days, commonly 30, 60 or 90. After it, an auto-renewing contract usually renews for a full term at the proposed price. The planner prints that date for every subscription.

How many seats should I renew?

The seats people actually used in the last term plus a buffer for hiring, rounded up and never above the seats you pay for. A 10% buffer is a common starting point; the planner lets you change it.

How much should I ask for?

Ask first to renew right-sized at today's per-seat price with no increase. That is the floor target. Anything beyond it, such as a multi-year commitment in return for a further discount, is the stretch target, and what the vendor agrees to is theirs to decide.
